adapter.label: Tailscale Funnel
adapter.needs: Needs Tailscale installed and signed in on this computer, with Funnel allowed on your tailnet and port 8443 or 10000 free.

durable.needs: Needs Tailscale installed and signed in on this computer, with Funnel allowed on your tailnet and port 443, 8443 or 10000 free.

address.scope: DNS name of this node plus a port: 8443, or 10000 when 8443 is in use, for a session; the first free port of 443, 8443 and 10000 for a durable route
conditions: one of those ports must be unused and the node policy must allow it for Funnel
the tailnet administrator must allow Funnel
node and tailnet identity stay the same

cost.summary: Free on the Personal plan (up to 6 users); Funnel is available on all plans, with non-configurable bandwidth limits.

disclosure.text: Publish this service over HTTPS on this device's Tailscale Funnel. A session uses port 8443, or port 10000 when 8443 is in use. A durable route uses the first free port of 443, 8443 and 10000. Existing listeners stay untouched. HTTPS, instance identity and timed SSE must pass before publication.

protocols.sse/streamableHttp: true. Backed by validation.sse (timed incremental event delivery when required) and validation.publish (exact-origin approval only after all required probes) in the wrapped recipe definition, with admission.requiredFeatures probe-assertions and client-vantage-probe.
protocols.oauthDcr: oauthDcr: Funnel publishes a stable HTTPS origin on the device's tailnet name and Gozar preserves the configured authority (Ingress.authorityHandling is configured-origin).
